global_rules.warmup: Complete the sequence once without approaching failure; stop movements that cause pain.
global_rules.duration: 40 minutes per workout is a target, not a validated duration. Warmup is included in the planned window.
global_rules.alternating_blocks: A → rest → B → rest → repeat; navigation is temporarily manual.
global_rules.transition_rest: Rest 120 s between single exercises or blocks, up to 180 s when needed. Transition rest replaces rest after the final set; do not add the intervals.
global_rules.unilateral_round: One unilateral round includes both sides. Walking movements alternate sides without resting after each repetition.

pre_t1.name: Push Warmup
pre_t1.notes: Complete the sequence once, without approaching failure. Warmup is included in the main activity duration.

exercises.notes: March briskly in place while moving your arms.
Perform controlled arm circles, starting small and gradually increasing their size.
On all fours with hands on the floor, gently shift your body forward and backward.
Keep elbows extended; draw the shoulder blades together and apart.
Perform easy push-ups with hands on a stable elevated support; then rest for 30 s.
Perform controlled wall-supported negatives without an excessively slow descent; reduce range of motion if difficult. Then rest 90–120 s before the first set.

pre_t2.name: Pull Warmup
pre_t2.notes: Complete the sequence once, without approaching failure. Warmup is included in the main activity duration.

exercises.notes: March briskly in place while moving your arms.
Perform controlled arm circles, starting small and gradually increasing their size.
On all fours with hands on the floor, gently shift your body forward and backward.
Keep elbows extended; draw the shoulder blades together and apart.
Perform easy Australian rows with a more upright body position; then rest for 30 s.
Perform comfortable pull-ups; then rest for 90 s before the first set.

pre_t3.name: Lower Body Warmup
pre_t3.notes: Complete the sequence once, without approaching failure. Warmup is included in the main activity duration.

exercises.notes: March briskly or jog lightly in place.
Move the knee forward while keeping the heel on the floor.
Stand with feet apart and bend one knee at a time without forcing the range of motion.
Perform calf raises using both feet.
Perform comfortable, controlled bodyweight squats.
Perform stationary lunges without jumping.
Start with low jumps and gradually increase height; rest 30–45 s between legs and 90 s before the main sets.

pre_footvolley.name: Footvolley Warmup
pre_footvolley.notes: Complete the sequence once, without approaching failure. Warmup is included in the main activity duration.

exercises.notes: Jog lightly for 30 s, shuffle laterally for 15 s alternating directions, and take short backward steps for 15 s.
Perform 10 calf raises, 5 squats and 4 lateral weight shifts per side through a comfortable range of motion.
Perform 5 forward and backward leg swings per side, 5 gentle trunk rotations per side, and arm circles.
Perform 3 movements of about 5 m, accelerating and stopping with control, followed by 3 low-to-moderate vertical jumps; walk back.
Use light foot, thigh and head touches, with a partner or alone; gradually increase movement to reach the ball.
